Brands

40 skincare brands in one combined popularity ranking — indie and mainstream together — researched October 26, 2026. Popularity scores are relative estimates (0–100) built from the evidence signals listed under each brand: search interest, social reach, retailer best-seller presence, and market reporting. They are not measured market share.

Products

16 researched products with their full INCI lists in label order. Prices are dated snapshots from the retailer named, not live quotes, and popularity scores are relative estimates backed by the signals listed.

Trade names A–Z

404 trade names with their supplier and the INCI entry each belongs to — tap an INCI name to open its full dossier. “As sold” gives the product’s composition as the supplier sells it, and where a trade name has been researched for supplier data, its “Supplier guidelines — as sold” panel shows the supplier’s own use level, phase, temperature and pH guidance for the product itself; anything the supplier does not publish is marked as not stated.

Compiled from supplier technical literature and public formulator-supplier pages; every entry lists its sources. Use levels and guidelines are starting points for bench work — always verify against the supplier TDS for your specific grade and run stability and preservative-efficacy testing before any commercial use.
